summary: Defines how Diameter agents should route requests when the User-Name contains a Network Access Identifier with multiple realms, called a decorated NAI. These are used to force a request along a chosen path of realms. It clarifies earlier behavior and is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A letter's address can list several post offices to go through. This document explains how Diameter helpers should read that list and pass the request along in the right order.

how are diameter requests routed by realm
